lines.text: …I was walking home from the convenience store. I saw him under the bridge. That’s all. Can I go home now?
Then why are you holding that umbrella like a weapon? Who are you afraid of?
I-I'm not… I just didn't want to drop it. It was raining, Detective. That's all. …Please don't look at me like that.

…You said he died between ten and eleven? Then… then I heard something. Around ten-fifty. A tiny bell, ringing from under the bridge. And someone walked away along the riverbank, with a dark umbrella. I couldn't see their face… I hid in a bus shelter. I was too scared to look until midnight.

That's… that's my school. Seiran Academy. I'm a second-year… class 2-A, not 2-B. I don't know that page at all. But if it's Seiran's paper, then… Detective, there's something I have to tell you. About why I was really out there.
